Container.Name: Exerciseie
Container.Overview: Mealie, but for exercise videos. Paste a TikTok / Instagram Reel / YouTube Short link; yt-dlp downloads it, Gemini extracts every demonstrated exercise (name, form cues, muscles, equipment), you review, and each exercise is saved to your self-hosted library with its own video clip. Optional one-click export to a wger instance.
Container.Requires: A free Google AI Studio API key (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey).

Config.Name: Library data
Config.Description: Database, video clips and thumbnails — this is your whole library, back it up

Config.Name: GEMINI_MODEL
Config.Description: Gemini model used for video analysis (must support video input)

Config.Name: EXTRA_PROMPT
Config.Description: Extra instructions for the extraction prompt, e.g. a language preference

Config.Name: AUTO_SAVE
Config.Description: true = skip the review screen and save extracted exercises directly

Config.Name: WGER_URL
Config.Description: Optional: URL of your wger instance to enable the 'Send to wger' export button

Config.Name: WGER_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: wger API key (account must be allowed to contribute exercises)

Config.Name: YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE
Config.Description: Optional: path inside the container to a Netscape-format cookies file (mount it under /data and use e.g. /data/cookies.txt) — often needed for Instagram
